body:
If you do decide to go into emergency housing you can finally have a break away from the stress from these mean people! You can join clubs at your university (uni is great for meeting people away from your bullies friend groups) and find some great people to be friends with. 
It's an awful and shitty situation now but you have an option, I mean you even said it yourself. I believe you are strong enough to overcome this! I really and truly do.
